# Foundation Disposition

Foundation reviewed the Application-owned response together with the separate Web-owned response in FCR-0092 and finds the current ownership model compatible and non-contradictory.

Preserved conclusions:
- Application business/domain state, commands, decisions, workflows, acceptance/rejection criteria and outcomes remain Application-owned.
- Shared Web may present/relay declared governed projections, queries, Owner requests, events and outcomes without acquiring business ownership or execution authority.
- `PRESENTATION_OR_TRANSPORT != BUSINESS_OWNERSHIP != AUTHORITY != EXECUTION` remains mandatory.
- `REQUEST_SENT != ACTION_ACCEPTED != ACTION_COMPLETED` remains mandatory end to end.
- Web shall not gain direct hidden access to Application-private databases, memory, credentials, internal components or undeclared routes.
- Generic Foundation transport/admission/security/platform/resource/lifecycle authority remains Foundation-owned.
- Application-specific payload meaning and business outcomes remain owned by the producing/receiving Application.
- Exact Shared Web internal shell/module/attachment/composition mechanics remain Web-owned and unresolved from Application ownership.
- Existing future Foundation obligations remain tracked separately by FCR-0009, FCR-0010, FCR-0016, FCR-0031, FCR-0076, FCR-0082 and other applicable FCRs. This clarification creates no duplicate Foundation capability request.

No additional Application-owned fact is currently required for the Foundation architectural reconciliation.

Foundation Triage: COMPLETE
Foundation Disposition: COMPATIBLE / CLARIFICATION_CONSUMED / NO_NEW_FOUNDATION_GAP_PROVEN
Requesting Workstream Verification: FOUNDATION REVIEW COMPLETE
